edits.old: Then no verdict is sent for either case and no chain sequence number is consumed
edits.new:
Then no verdict is sent for either case and no chain sequence number is consumed

  Scenario: AC10 The record holds only the verdict, the run reference and the gap flags and no personal data (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-agent contract mock returns the run of case "RW-2027-000501" with status "ANSWERED" and the gap flags MISSING_DOCUMENT and NO_VALID_APPRAISAL
    When rwb-agent sends the verdict "CORRECTED" with a coded reason for item "SUMMARY" of that run
    Then the final call is "CORRECTED", one of the values of the verdict list read as reference data
    Then the recommendation of the record is the run reference and the gap flags, and no summary text is stored
    Then the record is written in rwb_decision, sealed with an entry hash, published on rwb.decision-record.v1, and has no update and no delete
    Then the record, the event and the logs carry no name, no e-mail address, no mobile number, no national identity number and no account number

  Scenario: AC11 A request without credentials is answered 401 and nothing is written or read (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-agent contract mock returns the run of case "RW-2027-000501" with status "ANSWERED"
    When a caller sends POST /decision-log with the verdict "ACCEPTED" for that run and GET /decision-log for case "RW-2027-000501" without credentials
    Then each answer is 401 with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P7-E2028-APP-AC11)
    Then no decision record and no outbox row is written and no ledger row is read
